description_en: Submits a file to the development environment of the scheduling system and generates the corresponding node
description_zh: 提交文件至调度系统的开发环境，生成对应的任务
name: SubmitFile

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace ID. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectIdentifier parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks管控台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID。该参数与ProjectIdentifier参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the DataWorks console and go to the Workspace Management page to obtain the workspace name. You must specify either this parameter or the ProjectId parameter to determine the DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间名称。您可以登录DataWorks控制台，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称。该参数与ProjectId参数，二者必须设置其一，用来确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to query the ID of the file
parameters.help_zh: 文件的ID，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html查询对应文件的ID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.example: Submit a task for the first time
parameters.name: comment

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to skip the pre-deployment check after the file is submitted. Valid values:
false: does not skip the check. After the file is submitted, the pre-deployment check is automatically triggered. The file is ready for deployment only after it passes the check.
true: skips the check. After the file is submitted, the pre-deployment check is not triggered, and the file can directly proceed to deployment
parameters.help_zh:
文件提交成功后是否跳过发布前检查：
false：不跳过。文件提交后会自动触发发布前检查流程，检查通过后才会进入可发布状态。
true：跳过。文件提交后不会触发发布前检查流程，可直接进入发布流程
parameters.name: skip_all_deploy_file_extensions

Data.description_en: The ID of the deployment. You must use this ID as a parameter to call the [GetDeployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173950.html） operation to obtain the details of the deployment
Data.description_zh: 发布包的ID，后续需要将该ID作为参数调用[GetDeployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173950.html）接口，获取本次发布的具体情况

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to troubleshoot errors
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于出现错误后排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
